final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'NO_STATE') as state, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) as state_customer_count FROM Customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Accounts a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id) GROUP BY c.state_county_province), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(state_customer_count) as total FROM state_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT sc.state, sc.state_customer_count, CAST(sc.state_customer_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as share FROM state_counts sc, total_count tc), stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares), filtered AS (SELECT ws.state, ws.state_customer_count, ws.share, s.avg_share FROM with_shares ws, stats s WHERE ws.share > s.avg_share) SELECT SUM(state_customer_count) as combined_count, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess FROM filtered
